title: Select short status labels based on conditions
goal: Use a conditional expression to choose between two return values.
summary: The item registration page displays "can be collected" when the inventory is positive, and "To be replenished" when it is zero.
tasks: completes stockLabel(count), given a non-negative integer inventory, returns "can be collected" when the quantity is greater than 0, otherwise returns "To be replenished".
Use conditional expressions to use the result as the return value of the function.

example.note: The value after the question mark is the value when the condition is true, and the value after the colon is the value when the condition is not true.

hint: First write count > 0, and then add the two results.
